audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Vayne levels 2, 3 and first item and calls 4-5 and 6 even; the audited Neeko side puts rows 1 through 5 with Neeko.
audit.why: Range decides it: Tangle-Barbs roots from 1000, Blooming Burst pokes from 800, and Vayne must reach 550 to answer. She only takes over at two items. The directions must agree or mirror-fix.js overwrites this page.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 flipped to Neeko as one atomic paired group; row 0 Skill and row 6 Vayne unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] says to save 'Final Hour stealth for her Pop Blossom cast', and nowhere does the page state the actual tell.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: 'The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised.' So the wind-up you are meant to react to may not exist at all — that is the real mechanic, and it is more useful than a stealth claim I cannot verify.
audit.corrected: Pop Blossom leaps 600 and its preparation is hidden while she is disguised; Condemn is the answer, held on its 20s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No text gives Neeko's ranges or cooldowns, and Blooming Burst's second bloom is never mentioned.
audit.why: Blooming Burst is 800 range, 9s down to 7s, and 'blooms again on hitting champions or killing units'. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range, 12 down to 10s, and becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting after passing through a champion. Both change where you can stand.
audit.corrected: Real ranges and cooldowns written into the cooldown block and the Don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why and phases[5].why both promise Vayne's pattern taking over on rows that now belong to Neeko.
audit.why: A row and its explanation must say the same thing or the page contradicts itself on screen.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around her ranges and the hidden Pop Blossom preparation.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: 10.5s at rank 4, roots from 1000 and grows through a champion — dodge it, then step up. - Blooming Burst: 7s at rank 5, 800 range. - Pop Blossom: 120s at rank 1, and Condemn throws her out of it.

notes: suspectName on spikes[1] ('Her Pop Blossom') is a false positive — Pop Blossom is the real R name. Champion-wide, confirmed by the mirror audit: the entire full layer calls Vayne 'he/his' (enemyWin, tradeGood, dosFull, dontsFull, report[3], report[11], report[13]) while the content layer correctly says 'she'. That is a mechanical pronoun sweep across every vayne matchup, not per-matchup prose.
